about: An impact that reaches everything: every component is held to its checks and every path is unowned, so every check that must leave something out fails.

mutations.find: return { components: first([...reached, ...unresolved(components, reached)]), unowned: [...new Set(unownedOf(components, paths))].sort() };
mutations.replace: return { components: components.map((c) => row(c.key, "MODIFIED", "held to everything")), unowned: [...new Set(paths.map(norm))].sort() };
